I just wanted to pop on here and give my feedback of the store. In particular a sales consultant by the name of Nicola who assisted in the sale of Barbra Sturm skincare range.

I was amazed at how informative and helpful she was. She even put some of the cleansers on her hand to show me the texture (i had already used up both mine doing just that)! I asked for 2 samples which would last me a week which she delightfully did. She filled two whole jars which would give me a little over a week if I really spread it out!

The samples she gave me were full to the brim which allowed me to get a full “test” of the product. Upon paying at the cashier she mentioned that I was a level 3 member and I had redeemed a perfume. She then proceeded to show me 3 options for me to choose from (I of course asked her suggestion at this stage as I have already loved her service). Before paying, I had smelt some baccarat perfumes but wasn’t interested at that stage to invest in perfumes as I was just chatting to friends and enjoying smelling them. I have been in the beauty industry and retail for over 15 years and it’s been so delightful to experience such great customer service.

Because of the amazing samples and her service I went into store about 3-4 days later to buy the product she had sampled me but as Nicola wasn’t working that day another lady (didn’t catch the name) served me. She was lovely also and I had asked to try the “eye cream” as I had sampled the serum previously and she had filled the sample jar half way even though I mentioned I wanted a weeks worth. I understand maybe policy not to fill the sample jars but just wanted to mention because Nicola had filled the sample jars I had walked into store only 3-4 days later to buy two products valued at $780.00.
